description: Site-wide colors for the Promantia Custom Theme, preset to a dark palette with a lime accent. Each user activates it from Toggle Theme.

fields.description: The bar across the top of every desk page. Leave any color in this theme blank to keep Frappe's own default for that element.
fields.label: Navbar

fields.description: Behind the logo, breadcrumbs, search box and avatar.
fields.label: Background Color

fields.description: Logo text, breadcrumbs and the navbar icons (notifications bell).
fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: Hides the Help dropdown in the navbar.
fields.label: Hide Help

fields.description: Hides the Apps entry in the navbar settings dropdown.
fields.label: Hide App Switcher

fields.description: App the desk logo links to while the app switcher is hidden.
fields.label: Default App

fields.description: The search box in the navbar. The focused colors apply while you type in it, and the results colors to the list that opens below it.
fields.label: Search Bar

fields.description: The search box while it is not in use.
fields.label: Background Color

fields.description: Typed text, the search icon and, slightly faded, the placeholder text.
fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: The search box while you type in it. Blank keeps Background Color.
fields.label: Focused Background Color

fields.description: Typed text while the box is focused. Blank keeps Text Color.
fields.label: Focused Text Color

fields.description: The suggestions list that opens below the box. Blank follows Focused Background Color.
fields.label: Results Background Color

fields.description: Text of each suggestion in the list.
fields.label: Results Text Color

fields.description: The result under the mouse or picked with the arrow keys.
fields.label: Results Hover Background Color

fields.description: Page-level colors. With Dark Base on, Frappe's own greys, borders and text shades are generated from the first three colors here.
fields.label: Background

fields.description: Behind everything below the navbar. Also the default for Page Header Background, and with Dark Base the base of Frappe's grey scale.
fields.label: Page Background Color

fields.description: The main cards: forms, lists and workspace panels. With Dark Base, raised surfaces, field backgrounds and hover shades are lightened from it.
fields.label: Content Area Background Color

fields.description: Text inside the main cards. With Dark Base, also Frappe's body text, muted greys, borders and scrollbars.
fields.label: Content Area Text Color

fields.description: The sticky bar holding the page title and its action buttons. Blank follows Page Background Color.
fields.label: Page Header Background Color

fields.description: The page title and the sidebar toggle beside it.
fields.label: Page Header Text Color

fields.description: Turns Frappe's own text, borders, menus and dialogs dark-friendly. Keep it on with dark background colors, turn it off with light ones.
fields.label: Dark Base

fields.description: Main action buttons such as Save, Submit and + Add.
fields.label: Primary Button

fields.description: With Dark Base, also the accent: active highlights, focus rings, checkboxes, the selected date and highlighted suggestions.
fields.label: Background Color

fields.description: Button label. With Dark Base, also the text of the selected date in date pickers.
fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: Blank keeps Background Color on hover.
fields.label: Hover Background Color

fields.description: Blank keeps Text Color on hover.
fields.label: Hover Text Color

fields.description: Standard buttons such as Get Items From, Refresh, List View and the ... menu.
fields.label: Secondary Button

fields.description: Behind the button label.
fields.label: Background Color

fields.description: Button label and icon.
fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: Blank uses Frappe's own hover shade.
fields.label: Hover Background Color

fields.description: Blank keeps Text Color on hover.
fields.label: Hover Text Color

fields.description: The left column on workspaces, lists and forms.
fields.label: Sidebar

fields.description: Behind the sidebar column.
fields.label: Background Color

fields.description: Sidebar headings, workspace names and filter labels.
fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: The selected and hovered sidebar item. Also a selected row in report view.
fields.label: Active Item Background Color

fields.description: Every form field, list filter box and dialog field.
fields.label: Inputs

fields.description: Inside each field.
fields.label: Background Color

fields.label: Border Color

fields.description: Text typed into a field.
fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: The label above each field.
fields.label: Label Color

fields.description: List view, report view and the child tables inside forms.

fields.description: The column header row. With Dark Base, also Frappe's subtle background, which other apps' list headers use (NTPT sticky columns).
fields.label: Head Background Color

fields.description: Column header text.
fields.label: Head Text Color

fields.description: Each row of a list, report or table.
fields.label: Body Background Color

fields.description: Row text.
fields.label: Body Text Color

fields.description: The row under the mouse in list and report view. With Dark Base, also Frappe's highlight color.
fields.label: Row Hover Background Color

fields.description: The tab strip at the top of a form (Details, Payments, ...).

fields.description: Timeline entries and their timestamps.

fields.description: The vertical timeline line and its dots.

fields.description: Tile titles.

fields.description: Chart, card-link and quick-list widgets on workspaces and dashboards.

fields.label: Background Color

fields.description: The card outline.
fields.label: Border Color

fields.description: Single-figure cards such as Total Outgoing Bills.

fields.description: Behind each card.

fields.description: The card outline.

fields.label: Text Color

fields.description: Wherever Frappe shows a status: pills (Paid, Draft), form intro messages and pop-up alerts. Backgrounds apply to all three, text colors to pills and intro messages. With Dark Base, also Frappe's own green, amber and red tints.

fields.description: Text and dot of green status pills.
fields.label: Success Text Color
